- **要做：** 页面标题与导航一致；空状态改为「尚未从市场安装应用」。
- **完成标准：** 标题与导航一致，空状态不再归咎于筛选。

Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).
